description: Dynamically generated schema for urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.csd.CustomStructureDefinition=IMF:PIVOT_TABLE(1.0.0) (see pivot_table_csd.json), following the CSD schema generation rules. Its $id is the URN of the custom structure definition it was generated from, which is also the target namespace of the equivalent generated XML schema; it is an identifier, not a location, and the schema is not retrievable over http. It validates one instance object of the custom structure definition, that is one member of the 'customStructures' array of a structure message. Values are reported in their lexical form, as strings; a property whose maxOccurs is 1 reports its value directly, any other property reports its values in an array.

PivotTable.description: An instance of the IMF PIVOT_TABLE(1.0.0) custom structure definition (base 'Maintainable'). It extends CustomStructureInstanceType with the properties declared by the definition, and closes the object so that no undeclared property may be reported.

customStructureDefinition.description: Mandatory reference to the custom structure definition to which this instance conforms. The fixed value guarantees the reference matches the definition from which this schema was generated.

dataflow.description: reference ['Dataflow'], maxOccurs 1 and mandatory: the URN of the referenced dataflow.

RowColType.description: Generated from custom type RowColType (extends Nameable, sdmxClassName PivotTableRow). Restricts NameableType to require the id, which is used for the automatic generation of the object URN (e.g. urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.csd.imf.PivotTableRow=OECD:POP_SEX_AGE(1.0.0).SEX_ROW); the URN is derived from the instance and the object's own id and is not reported.

AbstractRowColType.description: The properties declared by the custom type RowColType, factored out so that they can be reused by the types which extend it.

level.description: format dataType 'Integer' minValue 0, maxOccurs 1: a non negative integer in its lexical form.

dimension.description: indirectReference targetClass 'Dimension' context 'dataflow', maxOccurs 1 and mandatory: the identifier of a dimension of the dataflow referenced by the 'dataflow' property of the pivot table. Resolution is validated by the system, not by this schema.

not.description: mutuallyExclusive: at most one of 'headingText' and 'headingCode' may be reported.

SliceType.description: Generated from custom type SliceType (extendsType RowColType, sdmxClassName PivotTableSlice). Extends the generated type of RowColType, adding only the subtype's own properties.
